title: Construction-Stage Credit Table: Allowance Return Share on Removed Design Studio Selections Lines
content:
The return share of package allowance on a removed Design Studio Selections option line is set by when and what was removed:

| Line removed | Construction stage of the agreement when it was removed | Return share |
|---|---|---|
| Cabinetry or countertop line | Foundation, framing, drywall, finishes or complete | 50 percent |
| Any other line | Foundation, framing, drywall, finishes or complete | 75 percent |
| Any line | Before construction started | 100 percent |

**Records read.** The category and the construction stage shown on the line's removal entry in the design ledger.

*Hypothetical cases:* a countertop line removed at framing returns at 50 percent; a flooring line removed at drywall at 75 percent; any line removed before construction started at 100 percent.
